name: Leader
notes: UTF-8 is /09 a. /06 and /07 per resource type, see the LDR/008 tables. BSR textual monographs: /17 blank, /18 i or c.

name: Control number
notes: Same ID on every update and delete, or the receiving system cannot match. e-ISBN is a common choice for e-books.

name: Control number identifier
notes: AG KVA: data provider in 003 and/or 040 $a.

name: Date and time of latest transaction
notes: Drives update detection on the receiving side. Keep it truthful.

name: Additional material characteristics
notes: PN: libraries cataloguing in OCLC or other shared databases must use 006/00 m when LDR/06 is not m.

name: Physical description fixed field
notes: 007 cr. PN lists /00 and /01 only; further positions are optional.

name: Fixed-length data elements
notes: Books vs continuing resources layout, see the LDR/008 tables.

name: LC control number
notes: PN: do not transfer the print LCCN to the e-record.

name: National bibliographic agency control number
notes: Assigned by the national agency (DNB records carry it). Take it from the DNB record; never construct one.

name: ISBN
notes: $q qualifying information (since 2013) replaces bracketed qualifiers. PN: one 020 $a per e-ISBN; other ISBNs in 020 $z; print ISBN also in 776 $z.

name: ISSN
notes: For DACH serials the ZDB record is the reference.

name: Other standard identifier
notes: Bare DOI in $a, no resolver prefix, no "doi:". The resolver URL belongs in 856.

name: System control number
notes: Prefix each number with its MARC organization code in parentheses. Only numbers for the e-version.

name: Cataloguing source
notes: $b = language of cataloguing (ger or eng). PN: $e rda followed by $e pn. OCLC keeps one record per language of cataloguing.

name: Language code
notes: AG KVA: first language in 008/35-37 and 041 $a; further languages repeat $a. PCC core if 008 cannot hold them.

name: LC call number
notes: BSR: at least one class number from an established scheme (LCC or DDC).

name: Subject category code
notes: Trade subject codes. Useful for mapping and routing, not a substitute for 082/084 or 650.

name: Dewey Decimal Classification
notes: DNB records also carry the DDC subject category (Sachgruppe) in 083 7# $a $q DE-101 $2 23sdnb (observed).

name: Other classification number
notes: AG KVA lists 082 and 084 with $2. RVK and BK are common in the union catalogues.

name: Main entry (100/110/111)
notes: AG KVA: first contributor with $4 and $0. One 1XX at most; editors go to 7XX.

name: Title statement
notes: No $h general material designation; content, media and carrier go to 336–338.

name: Varying form of title
notes: For journals, record title changes as 246 (minor) or new record with 780/785 (major).

name: Edition statement
notes: PN: only publisher editions, not provider versions.

name: Production, publication, distribution
notes: Replaces 260 under RDA. Second indicator carries the function; repeat for copyright.

name: Physical description
notes: RDA wording in the language of cataloguing (DNB: "1 Online-Ressource").

name: Current publication frequency
notes: CSR: core if known. Pair with 008/18–19.

name: Content type
notes: DNB records carry German terms (Text / txt).

name: Carrier type
notes: Must agree with 007 cr.

name: Accessibility content
subfields: ## $a content access mode · $b–$e assistive features · $2 source
notes: Optional, growing in weight with the European Accessibility Act. Only if it applies to all versions on a provider-neutral record.

name: Digital file characteristics
notes: File type in $a with $2 rdaft; encoding format such as PDF or EPUB in $b.

name: Dates of publication and sequential designation
notes: Unformatted note (ind1 1) when the first issue is not in hand.

name: Series statement
notes: Transcribed form. Pair with 8XX when traced.

name: General note
notes: Keep for genuine notes; not for package or licence data.

name: AI use disclosure (DataMercs core: when applicable)
subfields: ## $a AI use disclosed by the author: [activity]; [tool]; human-reviewed.
notes: AI is not an author (COPE, ICMJE), so no name heading. 500 because no specialised 5XX exists for it; 545 is for the creator's biography and 588 for the record. Name the activity with the STM classification of AI use where possible.

name: Formatted contents note (DataMercs core: e-books and edited volumes with a TOC)
notes: Core here wherever a table of contents exists: every chapter title, and in 00 every chapter author, becomes a search entry point. 00 for edited volumes and multi-author works; 0# for monographs or when only chapter titles are known. Complements the 856 42 $3 Table of contents link, does not replace it. Long contents: repeat 505, continuations with first indicator 8.

name: Restrictions on access
subfields: 0# $a Open access $f open access $2 coarar (or star) · $u COAR URI
notes: DACH: 506 0# $a Open access. PN: one general 506 for open-access versions, plus 856 $7 0. First indicator 0 = no restrictions, 1 = restrictions apply.

name: Summary (core: mandatory in this set)
notes: Mandatory here for e-books, e-journals and databases: abstracts drive discovery and relevance ranking, and OA titles almost always have one to reuse. One 520 per language. The market documents rate it optional.

name: Accessibility note
notes: Free-text counterpart to 341.

name: Terms governing use and reproduction
notes: AG KVA and PN use the same pattern. PN: only if the licence applies to all versions on the record.

name: Record licence: CC0 (DataMercs core)
subfields: ## $3 Bibliographic record $a Metadata in this record released under CC0 1.0 Universal. $f CC0 1.0 $2 cc $u https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ $q [MARC org code]
notes: Every record, separate from the resource licence above. $f, $2 cc, $u and $q are standard 540 subfields; using $3 to point at the record rather than part of the resource is a DataMercs extension. Reason: anyone can reuse, merge and enrich the record without asking.

name: Source of description note
subfields: 0# $a Description based on online resource; title from PDF title page (…, viewed …) · 1# latest issue consulted
notes: First indicator 0 = source of description, 1 = latest issue consulted.

name: Subject access (600–651)
notes: GND in DACH, LCSH in the US. $0 = authority record, $1 = real-world object URI.

name: Index term – uncontrolled
notes: Publisher keywords belong here, not in 650 without a source.

name: Genre/form
notes: BSR: genre/form access per cataloguer judgement, supported by authority records.

name: Added entries (700/710/711…)
notes: AG KVA: further contributors with $4 and $0.

name: Resource identifier
notes: Identifiers of related entities (work, expression). 856 stays the access URL.

name: Host item entry
notes: PN: not used for packages. DACH carries package data in 912 / 950 instead.

name: Additional physical form entry
subfields: 08 $i Erscheint auch als $n Druck-Ausgabe $z · 08 $i Print version: $t $z $w
notes: PN: required if the description is based on the print record. Reciprocal links recommended.

name: Preceding / succeeding entry
notes: For major title changes of serials.

name: Series added entries
notes: PN: authorised print form; print ISSN in $x as last subfield.

name: Electronic location and access
notes: $7 access status: 0 open, 1 restricted, u unspecified. Do not use $z for institution-specific notes on shared records.

name: Metadata provenance (DataMercs core: when applicable)
subfields: 0# / 1# $8 n\p $a [process] $c [0–1] $d [yyyymmdd] $q [MARC org code] $u [process URI] · $x $w $0 $1 if needed
notes: Required here for every machine-generated or AI-assisted field (520 abstract, 6XX subjects, 082/084 classes). ind1 0 = fully, 1 = partially, 2 = not machine-generated. Link with $8 and link type p, e.g. 520 $8 1\p ↔ 883 $8 1\p. DNB records carry it for machine-assigned subjects and classes (observed in live records).

name: AI tool trace (DataMercs extension, optional)
notes: Only if the tool must be indexed. No MARC relator code exists for AI, so $e is free text and $4 stays empty. Never 100/700.

name: Local fields: 912, 950
notes: DACH union catalogue convention: AG KVA uses 912 for the product ISIL and licence year, 950 for collection text.
